clinical.title: Academic Validation & Clinical Trial Data
clinical.card1_desc: Monsmecta's core ultra-fine (UltraFine) processing demonstrates overwhelming performance compared with conventional anti-diarrheal raw materials.
clinical.techSummaryBody: With more than 8 times the surface area (≥800 m²/g) and more than 50 times finer particle size (≤6.5 µm) compared with general montmorillonite, the physical adsorption and elimination of intestinal toxins and harmful viruses are maximized.
clinical.paperRef1: Smectite & Montmorillonite Toxin Adsorption & Anti-Diarrhea Global Research References
clinical.card2_desc: Test results based on the academic evidence of researchers at Gyeongsang National University College of Veterinary Medicine.
clinical.table2_row3_cond: Clinical experience with approximately 6,000 parvovirus enteritis patients
clinical.table2_row3_result: Helps shorten the symptom recovery period
clinical.card3_desc: Inhibitory effects by virus family of the DNJ component produced by Bacillus subtilis MORI, the core strain of DNG-1000.
clinical.antiviralSummaryBody: The DNJ component produced by the core strain of DNG-1000 (Bacillus subtilis MORI) was proven to significantly inhibit the replication of the 5 major virus families affecting cattle, swine, and poultry.
clinical.card4_desc: Monsmecta is currently having its clinical data validated through review meetings with veterinary experts.
clinical.card4_quote1: "The multi-virus inhibitory effects of 1-Deoxynojirimycin (DNJ) and its differentiated adsorption capacity for harmful substances are a clear point of differentiation."
clinical.card4_quote1_author: Prof. Bong-Kyun Park (Former Head of APQA, Authority in Virology)
clinical.card4_quote2: "Particle size, water absorption rate, specific surface area... it has all the data veterinarians want."
clinical.card4_quote3: "Beyond simple diarrhea treatment, its overwhelming palatability — even for patients with vomiting or abdominal pain — and instant pain relief make it essential as a first-line standby/prescription aid for the entire range of digestive issues."
clinical.card4_quote3_author: Dr. Dong-Jun Kim (Director of Sarang Animal Hospital)
clinical.card4_note: Monsmecta's academic and advisory board consists of veterinary experts including alumni of Seoul National University College of Veterinary Medicine, rigorously validating clinical data and prescription standards.

legal.privacyBody:
1. Information We Collect
• Orders: hospital name, director(veterinarian) name, business registration number, business type/items, billing email, delivery address
• Sample requests: hospital name, veterinarian name, phone number, shipping address

2. Purpose of Use
• Verifying B2B veterinarian(hospital) identity and processing orders
• Issuing electronic tax invoices and delivering products/samples
• Handling inquiries and regional exclusive supply information

3. Retention Period
• Order/invoice information: retained as required by applicable law, then destroyed
• Sample request information: destroyed within 6 months after delivery

4. Processing Entrustment & Cross-border Transfer
• Order and sample data are stored via Google Apps Script / Google Sheets (Google cloud, servers located outside Korea).
• Minimal information (recipient, address, phone) may be shared with courier companies for delivery.

5. Your Rights
• You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time.

6. Contact
• S&J Animal Hospital | TEL +82-31-321-6562 | E-mail Soonilhong@naver.com
legal.termsBody:
1. This service is provided exclusively for licensed veterinarians and animal hospitals (B2B).

2. All MONSMECTA products are supplied to veterinary hospitals only. Resale through online marketplaces or pet shops is prohibited.

3. Orders operate on a bank-transfer prepayment basis and are shipped sequentially after payment confirmation.

4. Due to the nature of the products, cancellation or return after shipment may be restricted for simple change of mind. For defective products, contact us within 7 days of receipt for exchange or refund.

5. Retail pricing is set independently by each hospital; the supplier does not intervene in hospital pricing decisions.
